page_title: JUV 1-0 FIO | Juventus v Fiorentina 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Moise Kean (Juventus) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
90+5' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+3' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Total attempts – 6:11.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
88' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
88' Fiorentina take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' Corner kick. Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic will be replaced by Moise Kean (Juventus).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dodo (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Michael Kayode can be given a rest.
83' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
83' Fiorentina hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
80' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
80' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:3.
77' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
75' Substitution. Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) has come on for Andrea Cambiaso.

74' OFF THE POST! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box. His effort was headed to the top left corner, but Wojciech Szczesny came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the post.
73' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
70' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the left post.
69' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
66' A rebound falls kindly for Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
66' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes a short corner kick.
66' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
64' Federico La Penna interrupts the game. One of the players from Juventus won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
63' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' The referee blows his whistle after Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
61' Here is a change. Christian Kouame is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) for Antonin Barak.
59' The substitution has been made. Samuel Iling Junior has replaced Filip Kostic (Juventus).
59' Substitution. Federico Chiesa will be replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
59' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
57' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

56' Filip Kostic (Juventus) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Filip Kostic (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Federico La Penna no option but to blow his whistle.
52' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
50' A pass finds the feet of Federico Chiesa (Juventus) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
49' The ball possession is 34:66.
46' The game is over for Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina). Maxime Lopez comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) is replaced by Riccardo Sottil.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' A pass by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
43' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

41' What a great effort! Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
41' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus).
36' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
33' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Juventus players aren’t happy.
32' Gooal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Weston McKennie. He makes it 2:0.
31' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
28' Juventus are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
26' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:0.
24' Dangerous play by Adrien Rabiot (Juventus). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Federico Gatti (Juventus) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
21' Bremer (Juventus) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from center of the box hits the left post!
21' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

20' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
17' The ball possession at the moment is 41:59.
14' Some patient build-up play from Fiorentina as they look to unlock the defence.
12' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Bremer (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
12' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The Juventus players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' The foul by Federico Chiesa (Juventus) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' A goal, which was scored by Weston McKennie (Juventus), was disallowed due to offside.
4' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna will supervise the game today.
